theorems.name: Submission.radon_exists_subseq_tendsto_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (μ : ℕ → Measure X), (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → ∃ C : ℝ≥0∞, C ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, μ j K ≤ C) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μ (φ j))) atTop (𝓝 L)
